subject: Novabank: proof points for tenant geolock + deletion acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Daniel Morris <daniel.morris@novabank.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Katie Ruiz <katie.ruiz@novabank.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Tenant geolock evidence — what we need to sign off

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As we move toward security approval for Dedicated, the InfoSec team asked me to consolidate a short list of concrete artifacts they need to accept geolock/region-binding and tenant deletion behavior. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following?

- A one-page runbook that describes the operational steps to evict a tenant from a particular region and verify all copies are deleted (including snapshots).
- Sample logs or an anonymized trace that shows a prior tenant eviction+scrub (timestamps, job-ids).
- A checklist of configuration knobs (pinning, backup replication policy, cross-region failover) and the default behaviors.
- SLA language we can include in our procurement docs showing the timeline for a committed region pin removal or data purge request.

We do not need production data — an anonymized example is fine. If you can point me to a template or share artifacts this week, I can get them to our legal and InfoSec for review.

Appreciate it,
Dan

--
Daniel Morris
Senior Cloud Security Manager | NovaBank
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Morris <daniel.morris@novabank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Tenant geolock evidence — what we need to sign off

Hi Dan — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a concise packet we typically share with customers going through procurement (see attachments). Quick answers inline: 

- Runbook: yes — we have an internal playbook and a customer-facing runbook. The customer doc is an operational checklist + verification steps (attachment: region-binding-checklist.xlsx).
- Logs/sample trace: we can provide anonymized evacuation logs and a redacted scrub trace (attachment: sample-evacuation-log.txt).
- Config checklist: included in the spreadsheet — default is no cross-region replication for pinned Dedicated tenants; backups are region-local unless explicitly configured for cross-region DR.
- SLA language: we do have templated timeline wording. For pinned region removal initiated by customer, our standard RTO for data purging (confirmation of wipe) is 30 days; we can discuss a shorter committed window under Dedicated SLA/contract.

I looped Ben from ops to confirm the technical bits and Laura from legal for any procurement phrasing. If you need a joint call with InfoSec to walk through the artifacts, we can schedule early next week.

Best,
Olga
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: region-binding-checklist.xlsx, sample-evacuation-log.txt
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Daniel Morris <daniel.morris@novabank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Jul 2027 15:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Tenant geolock evidence — what we need to sign off

Hi all — adding a little more color from an ops perspective. Key points: 

1) Eviction + scrub flow (high level):
   - Step 1: Create eviction job tied to tenant-id, record snapshot of current store (metadata only).
   - Step 2: Stop new writes, drain KV cache, run per-shard purge tasks.
   - Step 3: Sweep object-store buckets associated with tenant and tombstone entries.
   - Step 4: Trigger background snapshot-expunger and verify checksums removed from index.

2) Evidence artifacts we can provide:
   - Anonymized job-run logs (timestamps + job-ids) for a prior compliant purge.
   - Screenshots of internal job dashboards (we redact tenant identifiers).

3) Snapshots and backups:
   - By default, snapshots for pinned tenants are stored only in the pinned region. Cross-region backup must be explicitly enabled by the customer (and shows in the config flags column in the spreadsheet).

4) Timeline note: 30 days is our standard purge confirmation window to account for snapshot retention and downstream cold-archival retention. For procurement we can offer a contract clause that shortens that to 14 days for a committed Dedicated plan with an additional escrow/verification step.

I attached our customer-facing wipe playbook (wipe-playbook-v1.2.pdf) — Evan from infra signed off on the content. Happy to run a 30-min technical walkthrough with NovaBank InfoSec next Tue/Wed.

--
Ben Carter
Head of Dedicated Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachments: wipe-playbook-v1.2.pdf
From: Katie Ruiz <katie.ruiz@novabank.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 08:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Tenant geolock evidence — what we need to sign off

Thanks — this is helpful. Couple follow-ups from our InfoSec review: 

- The anonymized logs look good, but they want sample entries that demonstrate tombstone propagation to the index layer (if possible).
- For the SLA clause — could you provide two wording options: (A) standard 30-day confirmation, and (B) accelerated 14-day confirmation with the extra escrow verification we discussed? We want to present both to procurement.
- A short, redlined paragraph that we can drop into our vendor contract would speed legal review.

Can you send those by EOD Monday? If not, a firm time for the walkthrough call will also do.

—Katie
Senior Procurement Lead | NovaBank
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Ruiz <katie.ruiz@novabank.com>, Daniel Morris <daniel.morris@novabank.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 14:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Tenant geolock evidence — what we need to sign off

Katie — looping in formal procurement language and two options as requested. I attached a short contract snippet and included an inline redline for the accelerated option. Both options include: scope (pinned tenant definition), allowed exceptions (legal hold, subpoena), and verification steps (escrowed hash + third-party attestation if requested).

- Option A (Standard): "Redwood will confirm completion of region-bound data purge within thirty (30) days of the Customer's written request, subject to exceptions for legal holds or retention obligations. Redwood will provide anonymized purge logs and verification artifacts upon request."

- Option B (Accelerated): "Redwood will confirm completion of region-bound data purge within fourteen (14) days of Customer's written request, contingent upon Customer enabling escrowed verification and accepting a fee associated with expedited processing. Redwood will provide a third-party attestation summarizing purge job runs and will make redacted logs available for audit."

I've uploaded the redlined snippet and a formal checklist to the shared Drive folder. Ben/Olga — if this looks good, I'll send the final snippets and the Drive link to NovaBank procurement by EOD Monday.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: contract-snippet-geolock.txt (uploaded to Drive)
